title: 1338. Reduce Array Size to The Half

examples.explanation: Choosing {3,7} will make the new array [5,5,5,2,2] which has size 5 (i.e equal to half of the size of the old array). Possible sets of size 2 are {3,5},{3,2},{5,2}. Choosing set {2,7} is not possible as it will make the new array [3,3,3,3,5,5,5] which has a size greater than half of the size of the old array.
The only possible set you can choose is {7}. This will make the new array empty.
